steps.narrate: Here is how it works. The browser sends your prompt to a small Node server, which calls the AI model and streams the answer back.
The stack is deliberately simple. Node and Express on the server, server sent events for streaming, and a plain HTML front end with no build step.
The model does the core work for the user. We shape the prompt and supply context, and we check the output before it reaches the screen.
If the model call fails or times out, the app falls back to a saved answer, so the demo never shows an empty screen.
